findings.issue: Prompt gives sin25°=5/h without a length unit, but hints and solution state centimetres. Numerical result 11.83 is correct.
findings.suggestedReplacement: A right triangle has opposite side 5 cm and hypotenuse h cm, so sin 25° = 5/h. A learner writes h = 5 sin 25°. Correct the rearrangement and estimate h.
findings.status: Applied by parent; read-back verified explicit 5 cm opposite side and h cm hypotenuse. No source edits made by checker.
